title: Open High-Resolution Satellite Imagery: The WorldStrat Dataset – With Application to Super-Resolution
reasoning: The paper explicitly describes the dataset's focus on "sites of humanitarian interest, illegal mining sites, and settlements of persons at risk," sourced from organizations like UNHCR and Amnesty International.
